title: Exactness Certificates for Closed-Form CBF Safety-Filter Projections
summary: For control-affine systems, standard and high-order control barrier function conditions are affine in the control input and are commonly enforced through quadratic-program-based safety filters. Although convex, these optimization problems may be undesirable in embedded, high-rate, or resource-limited implementations. This letter characterizes when the corresponding Euclidean projection can be recovered from the affine inequalities violated by a nominal control input.
